notes.title: Quests are Less Grindy and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
FIXES

 Fixed clothes disappearing on death.
 Fixed melee attacks not working if there's a death entity in the attack zone.
 Fixed Event PVP not being displayed for enemy when an auto event start. 


CHANGES

 Quests are less grindy. For example, daily quest to kill boars, went to 35 to 10 kill count.
 The big medic house in Hajiwari inform where is the doctor location.
 Increased diamonds given in the Cash Shop.
110 -> 125
280 -> 350
590 -> 800

notes.title: New Item & Smo King Update
notes.notes:
IMPROVEMENTS
Sokat now drops a new item: Sokat's Pants.

CHANGES
Smo King auto event starts every 2 days.

BALANCE
Increased Smoke Grab speed 1200 ms => 950 ms.
Added 1 sec snare to Smokestorm.

notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.notes:
You can link your Discord account to your Pirate Souls one.
 You can display your achievements in game and on discord.
 Percentage of completion now displayed for achievements.
 Your position in your crew/division is now displayed.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42113318/acd5e9969a3a02f113bad9271067a96c3f057b55.png

notes.title: Battle Injuries Changes
notes.notes:
CHANGES

 Battle Injuries is now 8 sec at level 1 and increase by 8 seconds until level 30. 
 Battle Injuries max value is now 240 sec (4 minutes).
 There is now an alert message when adding stats while having Battle Injuries.

notes.title: Little Changes & Improvements
notes.notes:
IMPROVEMENTS

 Improved some Hajiwari maps like Lonely Road.


CHANGES

 Changed shotgun animation.
 50 berries is now needed to respawn on faction base after dying.


FIXES

 Slow down message shouldn't appear when warping on the same map.

notes.title: New Debuffs & Balance Changes
notes.notes:
CONTENT

 Tuco now drops sunglasses!
 Faction houses have an icon.
 There is a new role on discord if you want to be notified every time there is a World Blessing @Small Update.


BALANCE

 Added new debuffs in game! Burnt, Cut and Weakened!
 A lot of changes happened to rebalance the game with the new debuffs. Can't wait for your feedbacks!
 Greatly increased Faction War rocks and flags HP since it was still too easy to do it alone.


SWORDSMAN

 Devil Slash, King Roar and Air Cutter now have the Cut I debuff
 Cerberus Carnage now has the Cut II debuff
 Devil slash base damage reduced from 15 to 5
 King Roar base damage reduced from 20 to 10
 Air Cutter base damage reduced from 28 to 18
 Cerberus Carnage base damage reduced from 35 to 20
 Increase Cerberus Carnage cast time from 1.25 to 1.75

*Note: The base damage reduction does not change the final damage of the techniques with the Cut debuff*

FIGHTER

 Bone Breaker now has weakened I debuff
 Hotline and Blazing Legs First attack now have the weakened II debuff


SNIPER

 Firebird now has the Burnt I debuff


LEOPARD

 Claw Strike now has Cut I debuff
 10 Claws Impact now has a Weakened II debuff


REINDEER

 Strong Roseo and Horns Charge now has Weakened II debuff


RUBBER

 Sniper now has weakened I debuff
 Tank Shot and Giant Fist now has weakened II debuff


FIRE

 Fireflies now has the Burnt I debuff


ICE
[olist]
 Ice spike now has the Weakened II debuff
[/olist]

notes.title: Fixes & Changes
notes.notes:
FIXES

 Server disconnecting people should be fixed.
 Maps freezing should be fixed.


CHANGES

 Eating a soul fruit will fully reset your main stat.
 Improved UI rendering logic.
